create_random_dataset: create a RandomDataset instance to generate uniform random dense and sparse features for DLRM training
create_synthetic_dataset: create a SyntheticDataset instance to load pre-generated synthetic DLRM training data from disk
build_data_loader: build a PyTorch DataLoader for DLRM training using either random or synthetic data generation mode
generate_uniform_input_batch: generate a batch of uniformly distributed dense and sparse input features for DLRM model training
generate_random_output_batch: generate a batch of random target outputs representing click probability for DLRM training
